name: tree-model
summary: The stack learns to be an outline
body: stackTree replaces the rail layout: the stack stays a linearization (landing order is the spine), and dependency structure becomes indentation — a change nests under its deepest dependency (git-nearest on ties), diamond arms beyond the tree edge are kept as annotations, and every row carries its 1-based landing position so grouping by structure never loses the order. File-tree guide columns and elbow flags are computed here, pure and tested; malformed forward/self/unknown deps are dropped so the tree cannot cycle.
